title: Global Sample PLC files Form F-3ASR automatic shelf registration statement
bodyText:
FORM F-3ASR
REGISTRATION STATEMENT
Global Sample PLC | (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)

Automatic shelf registration statement of securities of well-known seasoned issuers.

This registration statement is filed by a well-known seasoned issuer and is effective immediately upon filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

BASE PROSPECTUS

We may offer from time to time ordinary shares, preference shares, debt securities, warrants, rights, and units in one or more offerings.

The securities may be offered separately or together and in amounts, at prices, and on terms to be determined at the time of sale.

PLAN OF DISTRIBUTION

We may sell securities through underwriters, dealers, agents, directly to purchasers, or through a combination of these methods.

USE OF PROCEEDS

Unless otherwise stated in a prospectus supplement, we expect to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes.
